Class VirtualStorage

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.VirtualStorage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Storage
public class VirtualStorage extends Object implements Storage
The escape hatch. Backed by a supplier (read) and a mutator (write), so consumers can bridge any external data source into MenuKit's Storage interface.

Implements plain Storage, not PersistentStorage. Persistence is the external source's responsibility, not ours.

Absorbs the old MKContainerSource / LiveContainerSource pattern where consumers provided arbitrary read/write callbacks.
